cards.def:
The duty to act for the benefit of society.
हिंदी: सामाजिक उत्तरदायित्व

A citizen's duty toward the community.
हिंदी: नागरिक उत्तरदायित्व

Active individual and collective participation designed to identify and address public issues.
हिंदी: नागरिक भागीदारी
examples: Attending town hall meetings is a fundamental form of grassroots civic engagement.
Youth civic engagement revitalizes democracy by injecting fresh perspectives into policy.
Community clean-up drives demonstrate the power of local civic engagement.
Civic engagement bridges the gap between everyday citizens and municipal administrators.

cards.def:
Behavior that is socially polite, orderly, dignified, and appropriate in shared civic spaces.
हिंदी: सार्वजनिक शिष्टाचार
examples: Maintaining public decorum includes speaking quietly on mobile phones inside commuter trains.
Littering and vandalism are serious violations of basic public decorum.
Elected representatives are expected to uphold the highest standards of public decorum in parliament.
Signage in libraries reminds patrons to observe quiet public decorum.

cards.def:
Voluntary work for the community.
हिंदी: सामुदायिक सेवा

Giving time freely to help others.
हिंदी: स्वयंसेवा

Generous giving to social causes.
हिंदी: परोपकार / लोकहित दान

The selfless practice of donating time, money, or resources to help others without expecting reward.
हिंदी: निःस्वार्थ दान
examples: The billionaire committed half his fortune to altruistic giving for global disease eradication.
Regular blood donation is a vital act of altruistic giving that saves thousands of lives.
Altruistic giving creates a ripple effect of generosity throughout local communities.
True altruistic giving focuses entirely on the needs of the recipient rather than personal glory.

cards.def:
The interdependence and mutual support that binds members of a community or nation together.
हिंदी: सामाजिक एकजुटता
examples: The national crisis brought forth an inspiring display of universal social solidarity.
Social solidarity ensures that the prosperous segments willingly support the vulnerable.
Universal public pensions are a practical institutional expression of social solidarity.
Labor strikes historically highlighted the transformative power of working-class social solidarity.

cards.def:
Shared duty of a group.
हिंदी: सामूहिक ज़िम्मेदारी

A legal or moral duty that every citizen owes to the state, community, and fellow citizens.
हिंदी: नागरिक दायित्व
examples: Voting in national elections is a fundamental civic obligation in any democratic republic.
Serving on a jury when summoned is an indispensable civic obligation of justice.
Paying lawful taxes faithfully is a core civic obligation that finances public infrastructure.
Protecting public property from damage is a shared civic obligation of all residents.

cards.def:
A binding duty.
हिंदी: दायित्व / बाध्यता

A formal democratic process through which communities inspect and evaluate public records and spending.
हिंदी: सामाजिक अंकेक्षण
examples: Village assemblies conducted a social audit to verify muster rolls for rural employment projects.
A transparent social audit prevents corruption by allowing citizens to examine project receipts.
NGOs trained local youth to lead the annual school midday meal social audit.
The municipal corporation mandated an independent social audit for all public sanitation works.

cards.def:
The quality of having strong, confirmed moral principles; complete honesty and uprightness.
हिंदी: सत्यनिष्ठा / नैतिक शुद्धता
examples: Public administrators must exhibit unquestioned probity in disbursing government funds.
The retired judge was chosen to lead the inquiry because of his reputation for absolute probity.
Financial probity requires strict adherence to ethical accounting standards and laws.
A lack of official probity breeds public cynicism and corrodes democratic institutions.

cards.def:
Behavior guided by moral principles.
हिंदी: नैतिक आचरण

The process by which an organization consults, communicates, and collaborates with all affected parties.
हिंदी: हितधारकों से संवाद
examples: The infrastructure corporation organized public meetings for active stakeholder engagement.
Effective stakeholder engagement ensures that local tribal concerns are integrated into project plans.
Sustainable business strategies depend heavily on transparent stakeholder engagement.
Neglecting stakeholder engagement often leads to protracted legal challenges and public protests.

cards.def:
The responsible use, management, and protection of natural and communal resources for future generations.
हिंदी: संसाधनों की देखरेख
examples: Farmers formed a cooperative dedicated to responsible groundwater resource stewardship.
Corporate resource stewardship entails minimizing raw material waste across factories.
Indigenous traditions offer profound models of long-term ecological resource stewardship.
Municipal water utilities launched awareness campaigns promoting household resource stewardship.

cards.def:
An acute awareness of and careful consideration for preserving delicate natural ecosystems.
हिंदी: पारिस्थितिक संवेदनशीलता
examples: Urban architects designed the eco-resort with deep ecological sensitivity to avoid tree felling.
Ecotourism guidelines require tourists to travel with strict ecological sensitivity.
Environmental impact assessments evaluate a project's ecological sensitivity before approval.
Cultivating ecological sensitivity in school children inspires a lifelong love for nature.

cards.def:
Achieving net-zero carbon dioxide emissions by balancing carbon emissions with carbon removal.
हिंदी: कार्बन तटस्थता
examples: Dozens of nations committed to reaching full carbon neutrality by the year 2050.
Tech conglomerates achieved operational carbon neutrality through massive solar investments.
Transitioning public transit fleets to electric power is crucial for municipal carbon neutrality.
Reforestation and carbon capture technologies play vital roles in attaining carbon neutrality.

cards.def:
The creative reuse of discarded materials or waste products into new items of higher quality.
हिंदी: अपसाइक्लिंग / बेकार चीज़ों से बेहतर वस्तु बनाना
examples: The fashion designer gained international acclaim for upcycling vintage denim into trendy jackets.
Upcycling old wooden shipping pallets into patio furniture diverted tons of timber from landfills.
Makerspaces teach workshops on upcycling discarded electronics into robotic toys.
Creative upcycling transforms household waste into stunning decorative art pieces.

cards.def:
The natural biological process of recycling decomposed organic matter into rich soil fertilizer.
हिंदी: खाद बनाना
examples: Kitchen vegetable peels and fallen garden leaves are perfect ingredients for home composting.
City sanitation departments distributed free bins to encourage community organic composting.
Composting organic waste significantly cuts down the volume of trash sent to urban landfills.
Using rich organic composting minimizes the need for synthetic chemical fertilizers on farms.

cards.def:
The deliberate protection, conservation, and restoration of the variety of plant and animal species.
हिंदी: जैव विविधता संरक्षण
examples: National wildlife sanctuaries are established specifically for intensive biodiversity preservation.
Coral reef ecosystems require urgent international action for biodiversity preservation.
Biodiversity preservation protects genetic varieties vital for agricultural and medicinal breakthroughs.
Deforestation poses the greatest immediate threat to planetary biodiversity preservation.

cards.def:
Concern for animals' well-being.
हिंदी: पशु कल्याण
examples: Animal Welfare laws must be enforced.

cards.def:
Concern for human welfare.
हिंदी: मानवतावाद

Immediate humanitarian assistance provided to people affected by sudden disasters and crises.
हिंदी: आपातकालीन राहत
examples: Helicopters air-dropped emergency relief supplies to stranded flood victims across the valley.
International agencies coordinated emergency relief teams following the devastating earthquake.
Emergency relief packages included clean drinking water, high-energy food, and first aid kits.
Volunteers worked round the clock setting up temporary tents for emergency relief.

cards.def:
Help after a disaster.
हिंदी: आपदा राहत

Well-being of society.
हिंदी: समाज कल्याण

The process of fostering peaceful, welcoming, and equitable inclusion of all groups into society.
हिंदी: सामाजिक एकीकरण
examples: Language learning classes facilitate the smooth social integration of newly arrived refugees.
Sports programs have proven remarkably effective in advancing youth social integration.
Social integration breaks down cultural ghettos and fosters vibrant intercultural neighborhoods.
Policies promoting mixed-income housing actively support long-term urban social integration.

cards.def:
The harmonious living together of diverse cultural communities within a shared democratic society.
हिंदी: बहुसांस्कृतिक सह-अस्तित्व
examples: Cosmopolitan metropolises celebrate multicultural coexistence through international festivals.
Multicultural coexistence demands mutual respect and genuine willingness to learn from others.
Schools serve as vital laboratories for cultivating the values of multicultural coexistence.
Legislation protecting civil liberties forms the legal framework for multicultural coexistence.

cards.def:
The principle that public services, facilities, and opportunities must be available to everyone without barrier.
हिंदी: समान पहुँच
examples: Building wheelchair ramps ensures equal access to public administrative buildings for all citizens.
Digital initiatives work to guarantee equal access to high-speed internet in remote villages.
Equal access to clean drinking water is recognized as an indispensable human right.
Public libraries exemplify the democratic ideal of equal access to knowledge and books.

cards.def:
The bottom-up organizing of ordinary community members to campaign for collective social change.
हिंदी: जमीनी स्तर पर जन-संगठन
examples: The environmental protection act was passed following relentless grassroots mobilization.
Grassroots mobilization empowers marginalized citizens to challenge powerful industrial polluters.
Door-to-door voter education drives are a classic method of democratic grassroots mobilization.
Social media platforms provide affordable, rapid communication channels for grassroots mobilization.

cards.def:
Public support for a cause.
हिंदी: पैरवी / वकालत

Knowledge of an issue.
हिंदी: जागरूकता

Making people aware and empathetic.
हिंदी: संवेदनशील बनाना

The practice of providing direct services, education, and resources to underserved populations.
हिंदी: सामुदायिक संपर्क कार्यक्रम
examples: The mobile dental van conducts free community outreach in remote farming hamlets.
Police departments hold weekly meetings to foster trusting community outreach with residents.
Public health workers expanded community outreach to raise awareness about child malnutrition.
University legal aid clinics offer vital pro bono assistance through community outreach.

cards.def:
A collective moral sense of responsibility for the well-being and justice of fellow human beings.
हिंदी: सामाजिक विवेक
examples: Investigative documentaries awakened the nation's social conscience regarding child labor.
A functioning democracy depends on citizens possessing an active, vigilant social conscience.
Literature and cinema play a powerful role in stirring the public's social conscience.
His deep social conscience compelled him to leave corporate finance and teach in public schools.

cards.def:
Leading with moral principles.
हिंदी: नैतिक नेतृत्व

Reporting wrongdoing.
हिंदी: भ्रष्टाचार का भंडाफोड़

Efforts against corruption.
हिंदी: भ्रष्टाचार-विरोध

Transparent and accountable administration.
हिंदी: सुशासन

Citizens' involvement in decisions.
हिंदी: जन भागीदारी

Non-governmental organizations and groups.
हिंदी: नागरिक समाज

A non-profit independent organization.
हिंदी: गैर-सरकारी संगठन

One who solves social problems through business.
हिंदी: सामाजिक उद्यमी

Benefit for all of society.
हिंदी: सामान्य हित / जनहित
